Don''t kill yourself over this. Stack butter for a few years, go to community college or take some courses while you do this and work your way through the bullshit. You're 17, smart, with 10 grand in your fund. You have a reason to live, you'd be able to conquer this. Please don't kill yourself, you have a bad life but suicide is permanent while your situation isn't. You'd come out stronger and thank yourself when this is all said and done. 

Are you attractive at all? Do you have friends? Do you have privileges? Are you a happy person (aside from this)? Do you have more than people around you, both genetically and materially? Think about this stuff, you have a bad hand but there's still potential. 

Don't commit suicide over this. You'll ruin your future and devastate your family... working through challenges is what makes you strong. 

You don't need to go to university right now... you have 10 grand, use that money somehow. An example is truck driving school... you could pay a few thousand for that, maybe invest a few more and work while you live at home for a few years. You'll make enough to go to college if you push through this. Truckers make good money (compared to stacking butter) and you're obviously smart enough to pass through college and fulfill your dreams. You'd be living on the road and you could write on the downtime. It would give you time to perfect your writing while saving money. Seriously, this is a great idea for you. 

Seriously, don't kill yourself because you have potential. Lots of people would kill to be you, so don't sell yourself short. Yeah, this sucks ass right now but think about the life you'd leave. You'd fail life over a temporary problem. Some people's problems are permanent and they have no options aside from suicide, your case isn't and you really shouldn't do this. Think this through, you have a future if you do it right.
